abstract: OBJECTIVE: To verify whether sperm from patients with a seminoma and patients with a non-seminoma present with an increased rate of apoptotic DNA fragmentation, when compared with men without testicular cancer and who had fathered a child in the 2 years preceding the study. DESIGN: Controlled prospective study. SETTING: Patients referred to a sperm bank in an academic research environment. PATIENT(S): Men with a diagnosed seminoma, men with a diagnosed non-seminoma, both after orchiectomy and before adjuvant therapy, and men with proven paternity in the 2 previous years. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURE(S): Rate of nuclear apoptotic sperm DNA fragmentation as assessed by TUNEL (terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase-mediated dUTP nick-end labeling) assay, classified as positive (with DNA fragmentation) or negative (without DNA fragmentation). RESULT(S): Of the 48 men with testicular cancer included in the study, 29 (60.4%) presented a non-seminoma and 19 (39.6%) a seminoma. Patients with non-seminoma presented with lower progressive sperm motility than the control group (57.4% and 66.3%, respectively), but both were still within normal ranges. Sperm concentration was lower in seminoma (31.2 x 10(6)/mL) and in non-seminoma (20.6 x 10(6)/mL) when compared with the control group (78.1 x 10(6)/mL), but values did not differ between the two testicular cancer groups. Sperm morphology was lower in patients with non-seminoma than in the control group (10% and 13.1%, respectively). Results for sperm nuclear apoptotic DNA fragmentation (mean; standard deviation) were 12.6%; 4.5% for the control group, 12.2%; 5.5% for the non-seminoma group, and 12.5%; 6.4% for the seminoma group. No differences were found between the three groups. CONCLUSION(S): Our results demonstrate that the presence of a seminoma or a non-seminoma is not associated with an increase in sperm apoptotic DNA fragmentation.
abstract_ja: 目的：セミノーマ患者および非セミノーマ患者の精子が、精巣がんのない男性で2年以内に父親となった者と比べ、アポトーシス性DNA断片化率が高いかを検証すること。デザイン：前向き対照研究。設定：学術研究施設にある精子バンクを受診した患者。対象：精巣摘除術後、補助療法前のセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ患者、ならびに直近2年以内に父親となったことが証明されている男性。主要評価項目：TUNEL法で評価した精子核のアポトーシス性DNA断片化を、陽性(断片化あり)か陰性(断片化なし)かに分類。結果：精巣がん患者48名のうち、29名(60.4%)が非セミノーマ、19名(39.6%)がセミノーマであった。非セミノーマ患者の進行性精子運動率は対照群より低かった(57.4%対66.3%)が、いずれも正常範囲内であった。精子濃度は、セミノーマ(31.2×10^6/mL)および非セミノーマ(20.6×10^6/mL)で、対照群(78.1×10^6/mL)より低かった。ただし両がん群間では差がなかった。精子形態は非セミノーマ患者で対照群より低かった(10%対13.1%)。精子核のアポトーシス性DNA断片化(平均、標準偏差)は、対照群12.6%(4.5%)、非セミノーマ群12.2%(5.5%)、セミノーマ群12.5%(6.4%)であり、3群間に差は認められなかった。結論：セミノーマまたは非セミノーマの存在は、精子のアポトーシス性DNA断片化の増加とは関連しないことが示された。
